decisions.text: type line: a regular series whose pattern of change is the point (06 DP6-1, G1.51)
the values are not far from zero compared with their spread
each line its own colour, handed out top to bottom by the line ends: East slot 1, North slot 3, South slot 4, West slot 2 (east, west, north, south fixed)
each line labelled at its end, in the text grey, packed in order: West moved 0.21 line heights, North moved 0.12 line heights, South moved 0.08 line heights
no point markers: no value is isolated and no straight run hides one
the unit phrase on the top label: “$30K in donations”; the top gridline starts after it
digits hidden: thousands, stated once on the top label (R2-05, D-3): “$30K in donations”
time axis: row 2 (“2022”) left out, the title gives it (G2.37)
